name: Fujin
subtitle: Guaridan of Air
description: Use Wind Strikes to Deflect AoE Damage and Protect your Allies from Debuffs and Disables.
lore: Both demon and god, Fujin carries the Four Winds, using them to fly and leaving powerful gusts and gales in his wake. Although a source of destruction, Fujin is not a being of evil per se. Rather, Fujin simply does not care, traveling where he will and brawling with whoever he likes, in utter disregard of the damage his winds cause.
divinity_generator: Gain [30] Divinity when hit by an enemy which is increased by 100% if the attack is AoE Attacks.

awakening_bonuses.bonus: Barrier Multiplier +30%, DMG Reduction Multiplier +20%, DMG Multiplier +30%
Attunement Multiplier +50%, Weapon Multiplier +30%, Armor Multiplier +30%
Awaken the ability: Winds of Change

skills.name: Windwall
skills.description: Attack all enemies (210%DEF+120%ATK) and place [mechanic:protect-ii] on all allies except this hero. Then place [mechanic:stalwart] on all allies for 1 turn. If Raijin is on the team, place [mechanic:ward] on him.
skills.awakening_bonus: Transfer all [Debuff] from all allies instead. If Raijin is on the team, increase his turn meter by 20% for each [Debuff] transferred.

skills.name: Winds of Change
skills.description: Transfer 1[Debuff] from each ally to this hero, then attack 1 enemy (210%DEF+120%ATK) and transfer all [Debuffs] from this hero to the target. For each [Debuff] transferred, increase all allies [mechanic:barrier] 50%DEF. If Raijin is on the team, transfer all [Debuffs] to this hero instead.
skills.awakening_bonus: If an ally is attacked by AoE Attacks while under [Protect], place Barrier 50%DEF on them.

skills.name: Gust of Wind
skills.description: Attack all enemies (210%DEF+120%ATK) with a 30% chance to place [mechanic:res-down-ii] on each target for 2 turns. If Raijin is on the team, he will also join the attack.

skills.name: Cyclone Barrier
skills.description: Allies receive 30% decreased damage from AoE attacks.
skills.awakening_bonus: Reflect 25% of the reduced damage back to the attacker. If Raijin is on the team, reflect 100% of the damage reduced by him.

imprint_passive: Reduce the damage this hero receives from AoE Attacks by 15%.
